repro_signature: Unit: cargo test --locked -p pa-cli --test interactive_daemon_e2e (CI shard-4/4 unit; scripts/ci_test_shard.py has NO per-unit timeout, so the hang eats the whole job). On a wedge: (1) the other 31 tests complete; the last standing test is tui_submit_outlived_by_switch_stays_silent_on_the_new_session (libtest 'has been running for over 60 seconds'; binary never exits); (2) alive at kill: test binary + cargo + EXACTLY 3x prime-agent = 1 daemon supervisor + 2 session workers (the test creates 2 sessions via the daemon pre-run, so the trio is the test's own); (3) the test thread is parked in Runtime::block_on at interactive_daemon_e2e.rs:4389 (the run_interactive await), TUI loop ALIVE ticking its ~50ms select cadence forever (epoll timeout=48); (4) the ENTIRE trio is IDLE (all tokio workers condvar/mio parked; no runnable thread); (5) daemon-side work COMPLETE: both sessions' turns ran + persisted ~1-2s in ('for a'/'a turn reply', 'for b'/'b turn reply' in the session JSONLs; daemon log: both workers registered+re-registered then silence; worker stderr empty); (6) => the TUI-side headless EXIT GATE never opens (no timeout guards it): a submit/switch round-trip settle member never drains. Observed instances: CI attempt-1 job 108526878090 (41min cancel, 3x prime-agent orphans, zero test output); drain-idle VM base arm (30+min kill); triage trials PRE#01, POST#02, POST#08, POST#44 (+any later; see trial_matrix).
mechanism: The headless exit gate (crates/pa-tui/src/interactive.rs, the post-input-drain break) requires the FULL settle: headless_done && pending empty && !turn_active && prompt_submits_in_flight()==0 && view.queued empty && !dirty && !share/reload/traces/auth pending — NO timeout. prompt_in_flight drains ONLY in apply_prompt_outcome (session_ui.rs) when the prompt-submit round trip resolves and its PromptSubmitNote lands on prompt_rx. The outlived test arms exactly one round trip ACROSS the switch: Submit 'for a' -> Submit '/switch <second>' (the reply is delayed 400ms to land provably post-switch) -> WaitIdle(30s) x2 -> HeadlessDone. The WaitIdle barriers time out (30s note), so the PLAN cannot hang past ~60s — and the daemon saw both turns complete ~1-2s in. The forever-hang is AFTER HeadlessDone: one settle member never drains in the post-switch bookkeeping. Consistent with the outlived submit's round-trip note / turn-end / queue-drain marker never ARRIVING on the post-switch subscription (dropped between detach and re-attach, or routed to the pre-switch subscription) — a lost-settle race between the switch and the in-flight round trip. NOT excluded by the evidence: a turn-end marker consumed by the stale-session filter leaving turn_active latched, or a queued-item drain marker lost the same way. All shapes share the fingerprint and the fix territory: bound the exit gate's settle wait (converts the family from a 30-45min hang into an attributable red) and/or flush the in-flight submit bookkeeping at the switch.
parity_notes: TS reference: interactive-mode.ts's staleness guard (promptStashSessionId/inputSubmissionGeneration) is the semantics under test; the exit gate is Rust-harness-specific (the headless verification harness has no TS counterpart), so the unbounded settle wait is a harness-side Rust gap, not a TS parity delta.
